banned.why: Cosmetic claims cannot state the product repairs or heals - that implies altering body structure/function, making it an unapproved drug claim.

banned.claim: Boosts collagen production for younger hands
banned.why: Claiming to boost collagen production is a structure/function drug claim not permitted for cosmetics.

banned.claim: Treats or prevents eczema, dermatitis, or dryness conditions
banned.why: Treating a skin condition is a drug claim; gemi may only speak to appearance and feel (e.g. 'feels soft').

banned.claim: Anti-aging - reverses signs of aging on hands
banned.why: Reversing aging is a structure/function claim; use appearance language like 'hands look smoother' instead.

banned.claim: Clinically proven to strengthen the skin barrier
banned.why: 'Clinically proven' requires a supporting study on file; without one it is an unsubstantiated claim. Prefer 'helps support the skin barrier.'

banned.claim: Guarantees protection against illness or viruses
banned.why: Goes beyond the substantiated '99.9% of common germs' efficacy and implies a medical/disease-prevention claim.
